description: This file defines the 'Language' entity class used within the OrangeHRM system. It describes language data related to employees, including properties for ID and name, and a collection of related EmployeeLanguage entities. It uses Doctrine ORM annotations for database mapping.

classes.name: Language
classes.description: Entity class representing a language within the HRM system, with properties for id, name, and associated employee language records.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the language.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the language.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the language.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the language.
